propositions: Agents file bugs outside an epic hierarchy and link them caused_by, but the direct-children close gate cannot detect them; a deterministic caused_by floor must block closes when an open/in_progress bug records caused_by into the epic's subtree.

Legitimate deferrals (proven pre-existing, filed before close, superseded by separate epic) must not block closes; the gate requires an LLM screen to distinguish defects-in-deliverable from pre-existing or unrelated bugs, keyed on haiku forced-choice A/B/C with store-grounded disposition adjudication.
The candidate filter must enumerate open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition or linked any-relation any-depth to the epic subtree, ceiling 32 with overflow tally.
Screen failures and unlinked orphans degrade open (not block); only a defect-in-deliverable with no recorded disposition (supersedes/duplicates link or reasoned prose) blocks the close.
A-verdicts from the haiku screen forward to the verifier as at most 8 compact candidates (title+citation+id) appended inside the precheck-assembled fenced context via the overlap_verdict idiom.
Screen output must ride model-class config + shared cache settings (TRIVIAL_CLASS, warm-then-fan-out pattern), with normalizing validator defaulting out-of-vocabulary verdicts to C (unrelated).
